tagline: The Baltic's medieval jewel — a walled old town of towers and cobbles that runs one of the world's most digital countries.
overview: Tallinn's Old Town is one of Europe's best-preserved medieval centres — a UNESCO-listed maze of guild houses, merchant towers and intact city walls that survived the 20th century almost untouched.

Up on Toompea hill, the Estonian parliament sits in a pink baroque castle above Orthodox Alexander Nevsky Cathedral's onion domes; below, the lower town's Raekoja plats has hosted markets for 800 years. Beyond the walls, Telliskivi's former factories are now the creative city — street art, food halls and startups.

Speed's 2024 tour streamed from Tallinn. It's also Europe's digital pioneer — e-residency, paperless government and the birthplace of Skype — making the medieval streets an oddly fitting HQ for a tech nation.

funFacts.title: BEST-PRESERVED MEDIEVAL TOWN
funFacts.text: The old town's walls, towers and lanes survived two world wars mostly intact.

funFacts.title: 2 KM OF WALL
funFacts.text: About half the medieval city wall still stands — with 20 towers you can visit.

funFacts.title: SKYPE'S BIRTHPLACE
funFacts.text: Skype was built in Tallinn in 2003 — seeding Estonia's startup scene.

funFacts.title: E-RESIDENCY
funFacts.text: Estonia offers digital residency to anyone — the world's first country to do so.

funFacts.title: A PINK PARLIAMENT
funFacts.text: Toompea Castle, housing parliament, is painted baroque pink.

funFacts.title: 800-YEAR-OLD SQUARE
funFacts.text: Raekoja plats has run a market since the 13th century — Christmas market included.

funFacts.title: THE OLDEST PHARMACY
funFacts.text: Town Hall Pharmacy has operated continuously since 1422.

funFacts.title: TWO TOWNS IN ONE
funFacts.text: Upper (nobles') Toompea and lower (merchants') town were once rival cities.

funFacts.title: SINGING REVOLUTION
funFacts.text: Estonia's path to freedom was literally sung — mass choirs defied the Soviets.

funFacts.title: TELLISKIVI
funFacts.text: The creative city in old railway factories is the hip district's engine.
